subject: colouring tiplabels - error says I have 105 tiplabels but I really only have 53

messages.author: 112a116ba16ec2aa
messages.subject: colouring tiplabels - error says I have 105 tiplabels but I really only have 53
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to colour the tips on a tree by a character vector, and when I use the following code I get the following error: 

ggtree(rbcl_MLtree,ladderize = T,right = F,size=0.5 ) +
  geom_tiplab(size=4.5, hjust = -0.060, fontface="bold", 
        aes(colour=(newrbcl_tiplabs$locale ))) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")) +
  ggtitle("ML rbcL tree alignment of 1255 bp") +
  
  geom_nodelab(hjust=-0.05,size=3,fontface="bold") + 
  geom_treescale(x=0,y=37,linesize = 0.5,fontsize = 4) +  xlim(0, 1.7) 

Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (105): colour
   
The vector (newrbcl_tiplabs$locale) is a list of 53 place names, corresponding to each tip label. I thought maybe it was counting node labels, but it is not. I have 104 edges plus the root, so I am surmising that is that is counting? But if I do give it a list of 105 places to colour, it only colours the tip labels, and none of the edges. So it is behaving really weirdly, and I have yet to solve this. 

Any help would be great! 
Best,
Kurt

messages.author: fa1e85b72b50d60b
messages.subject: Re: colouring tiplabels - error says I have 105 tiplabels but I really only have 53
parts:
Obviously two separate data frames are being called, and I don't think such a call would be acceptable to ggplot at all.

I suggest you deal with the two data frames first, merge the two or create a link between them.

Here are some codes for you to reference:

The example in subsection 6.4 of treedata-book/chapter6 is appropriate for your needs
